name: HighLevel
description: HighLevel lets agents read and update contacts, conversations, opportunities, and calendars in one HighLevel sub-account. Each user connects with a Private Integration token and the location ID of their own sub-account.

prompts.text: List the contacts that were added this week.
Summarize the opportunities in my sales pipeline by stage.
What appointments are booked on my calendar tomorrow?

apps.name: HighLevel
apps.description: Contact, conversation, opportunity, and calendar access, over HighLevel's MCP server with a Private Integration token.

fields.label: Private Integration token
fields.hint: In your HighLevel sub-account, open Settings > Private Integrations and create a token.

fields.label: Location ID
fields.hint: In your HighLevel sub-account, open Settings > Business Profile and copy the Location ID.
